messages:
ajay-partners: Quick sync — building a Private Telemetry Quickstart kit for SI & HW partners. Goals: one-click Datadog dashboard bundle + OTLP collector config, airgap install flow, sample LLM trace set, 3-min demo video. cc @maria-prod @leo-obs
maria-prod: +1. Please include minimal terraform + k8s manifests. Also a small prompt->inference trace example that shows tokenized spans and cache hits.
leo-obs: I'll own the Datadog dashboard JSON & queries. Suggest standardize on otelcol v0.58 and dd-agent 7.x. Any objections?
katie-ops: Airgap packaging: we have bundle-airgap.sh that builds tar + signatures. Need a small runbook for customers (install, verify certs, enable local OTLP endpoint).
hideo-si: From SI side — preference for a prebuilt demo VM image and step-by-step "no infra" guide. Also include optional exporters for Splunk/ELK for customers who don't use Datadog.
sam-se: Co-marketing note: PM wants a 2-week turnaround for a co-branded 3-min demo + one-pager. Is that realistic? We'll need a short script and captions.
ajay-partners: Timeline proposal: week1 assets (manifests + collector config + dashboard), week2 demo recording + quickstart doc. Assign: maria (manifests), leo (dashboards), katie (airgap), hideo (SI playbook), sam (demo script).
maria-prod: ack. starting a repo skeleton in private: https://git.internal/rw/telemetry-quickstart (WIP)
leo-obs: Dropping a sample query for model traces: 
```
avg(last_5m):trace.duration{service:inference,model_name:rw-gpt-13b}
```
will add dashboard json to PR.
katie-ops: Airgap checklist (short): 1) verify bundle signature 2) install local otelcol 3) configure dd exporter key 4) run smoke tests — will add checklists to repo.
hideo-si: We'll prep a VM image and a small "fake workload" generator (python) that emits OTLP traces and metrics. Can demo offline inference traces linking to request_id + model_id.
ajay-partners: Nice. One more ask: include a short consent/note about telemetry data residency for regulated customers. Legal ok? @maria-prod @katie-ops
maria-prod: looping in legal in the repo PR for wording. I'll add a privacy note template.
sam-se: I'll draft the demo script and share by EOD Monday. If everyone's OK I'll schedule a 30m runthrough Thurs.
deploy-bot: CI started for rw/telemetry-quickstart — build #72 (tests: unit+lint)
leo-obs: got the CI note :thumbsup: will push dashboard PR after tests pass.
ajay-partners: Great progress — thanks team. We'll do a short sync Thurs 10am PT. Agenda: review assets + recording plan. :party:
